2. According to the applicant, he is having deep roots in the society and he is in the business from the last 30 years and as such, has earned goodwill through his hard work, character and behaviour.
3. According to him, he is a married person having two children.
According to the applicant, he has nothing to do with the offences, for which, he has been named as accused in this case.

4. According to him, he is an innocent person and has falsely been implicated, in this case and now he is apprehending his arrest in the above referred case.
5.
According to him, he is permanent resident of Solan and as such, there is no likelihood of the applicant fleeing away from the course of justice.
6. The applicant has given certain undertakings, for which, he is ready to abide by, in case, the application is allowed.
5. When put to notice, the police has filed the status report disclosing therein that on 21.06.2023,

The accused, alongwith one lady, who has been introduced as wife of the applicant, used to purchase cloth from the shop of the complainant.
Due to this fact, they came to know each other.

6. Once Chaman Lal (applicant) has apprised her that he is having a very profitable project of preparing medicated mineral water and allured her to invest Rs.20,00,000,/- (Twenty lac) on the pretext that she will get huge profit.

Acting upon the said allurement of the applicant, the complainant has invested a sum of Rs. 5,00,000/- on 14.10.2022, by transferring the same to the Chaman Lal Garg vs State Of Himachal Pradesh on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174850020/

She has also paid a sum of Rs. 5,00,000/- to Himmat at Dharampur.

At .
that time, they had parked their MG Hector vehcile bearing registration No. HP-14C-3838 at a secluded place.
Chaman Lal and Himmat were consuming liquor at that time.
They had requested the complainant to come inside the vehicle.

When, she entered inside the vehicle, they started doing obscene acts with her, upon which, the applicant screamed, then, Himmat disclosed her that he is an ex-serviceman and thereafter he has threatened the complainant with revolver.
7.
The complainant further got recorded that she had resisted to the acts of the accused, but both of them were threatening her.

Due to their behaviour, the complainant had changed her idea to invest in the project and requested them to return the money, upon which, the accused persons threatened her that in case, she will demand her money back, they will defame her.
When she has demanded the money back from Chaman Lal, instead of returning the money, he has threatened to kill the complainant as well her family.
8. She has also mentioned in the complaint that the accused persons have threatened her that they are having connection with the gangster Lawrance Bishnoi and other gangsters.

Due to this fact,
complainant remained silent.

. 
9. Lastly, she has mentioned in the complaint that she has obtained a sum of Rs. 2,60,000/- by mortgaging her ornaments with Muthoot Bank.

When she has discussed this matter with Dr.
Rajinder Chabra and Raj Kumar Gill, both of them had advised her to go to police.
10. On the basis of above facts, the police has registered the case and police machinery swung into motion.
Thereafter, statement of complainant under Section 164 Cr.P.C was recorded.
She has alleged in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C that on 19.09.2022 both the accused has served some drink to her and after drinking the same, she became unconscious.
11. It is the case of the police that accused Himmat is not available at his house and he is being searched.

However, accused Chaman Lal (applicant) has joined the investigation on 15.07.2023 and the matter was inquired from accused Chaman Lal and he is co-operating with the investigation and the investigation is still going on.

At the time of deciding the bail application, detailed discussions about the case of the prosecution should be avoided as it would cause prejudice to the prosecution, as well as, to the accused.

14. The applicant is the permanent resident of District Solan and there is no whisper in the status report that in case, the application is allowed, the applicant will coerce the witnesses or may not be available for the trial.
15. The accused is presumed to be innocent till his guilt is proved during the trial.
The application cannot be dismissed as a matter of punishment as pre-trial punishment is prohibited under the law.
16. Considering all these facts, this Court is of the view that the relief, which has been granted to the applicant, vide order, dated 14th July, 2023, is liable to be confirmed.
Consequently, interim order, dated 14th July, 2023, is made absolute.

Therefore, it is ordered that the applicant be released on bail, in the event of his arrest, in FIR No. 22 of 2023, dated 21st June,

The bail is granted, subject to the following conditions:
a) That the applicant will join the investigation of the case, as and when, called for, by the Investigating Officer, in accordance with law;
b) That the applicant will not leave India, without prior permission of the Court;
c) That the applicant will not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person, acquainted with the facts of the case, so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Investigating Officer or the Court; and d) That the applicant shall regularly attend the trial Court on each and every date of hearing and if prevented by any reason to do so seek exemption from appearance by filing appropriate application;
17.
Any of the observations, made hereinabove, shall not be taken as an expression of opinion, on the merits of the case, as these observations, are confined, only, to the disposal of the present bail application.
